text_block_list.name: Horsegirl A
text_block_list.text:
Ah, a poster about the festival.
And they've got fireworks too.

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl B
text_block_list.text:
There's a rumor that if you head in to the
mountains from 
here,
you can also find a place to see
fireflies.

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl A
text_block_list.text:
I want to go but…… we're at training
camp, 
so I want to concentrate on that.
Even if training's 
over, I don't want to lose focus.

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl B
text_block_list.text:
Right. There's only a little time 
left at camp…… yeah, let's do our best!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
――And that's what happened.
I want to go and have some fun but, 
everyone's working hard so it didn't feel
right to ask them……
choice_data_list: Then, should I go with you?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
But, Trainer-san,
aren't you really busy? Like, 
preparing for training,
and how you're always with me――

She felt apologetic so Hishi Miracle spoke
in a small 
voice.
I told her that she didn't need to hold
back.
choice_data_list: To think you'd be trying to be con...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Wai- what do you mean by that!? 
Usually, I'm a considerate girl though!?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Haaa. Whatever~. In that case,
I won't hold 
back. I'll have Trainer-san accompany me.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Ah, but.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Well…… since we have the chance,
rather than the festival…… 
just for today,
do you want to try something special?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Hmmmm~, they don't seem to be here,
huh…… I 
guess the fireflies were just a rumor after
all.
choice_data_list: We probably shouldn't go much further

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
You're right. Sorry about that.
I didn't even 
really know the location and brought you
along.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(I just wanted to show them scenery that
was out of the ordinary…… Is this what
happens 
when you do something you're not used
to~?)

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Haaa, that's unfortunate. I thought 
it'd be a good way to show my gratitude.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Ah…… did I say that out loud?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Uhh~~~……well,
you see. It's just something 
that I've been thinking about for a while
now.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
See, Trainer-san,
when it comes to races…… you 
always have really high expectations for me,
right?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
And, I just want to live up to those
expectations, you 
see. At least,
that's what I've been thinking anyways……

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
But if it's just this,
I really wonder if it 
matches up to Trainer-san's passion.
That's 
what I've been thinking and it made me
worry.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
At the very least,
with this I could repay 
that favor a little bit…… is what I had
hoped, but as you can see,
things didn't work out.
choice_data_list: I'm happy you feel that way

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha. Since it's Trainer-san,
I figured you'd say that. 
For my part,
I haven't been thinking too deeply about
it.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
The next time there's an opportunity,
let me repay the favor.
It's fine if you don't think too 
deeply and just think of it as a simple
thanks.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(……But well,
it is a bit unfortunate though.)

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(With how vast the sky is,
it kind of feels special after all.
If it all ended with us 
seeing fireflies I would have felt better
too)

She didn't seem to be that depressed. ……But,
it probably 
wasn't wrong to think she was a little
disappointed.

She really didn't need to thank me. Just 
hearing that she was trying to respond 
to my expectations was more than enough.
choice_data_list: Then, I wonder what I'll have you do!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Eh?
choice_data_list: Add more training time? Or maybe――

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
No no no! 
I said if there was another opportunity,
didn't I!?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Besides,
would that even count as a thank you!? 
I'd do that anyways, if I needed to.

Hishi Miracle let out a small laugh. 
It seems like she understood that I was just
joking.

――She really didn't need to match up to my
passion. 
But, if she wants to run,
and starts to want to win……

If she wants to do her best to match those
expectations, 
then naturally, I'll support her.
choice_data_list: Wanna run all the way back to school?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Wouldn't that mean you'd be coming with me,
Trainer-san? 
I think it'd be rough,
even with a bicycle though.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Geez,
you're real quick to start fooling around.
I did 
think we were having a serious conversation,
you know~?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Hmm……

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: I-I wouldn't say that……

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
C'mon! That's an exaggeration! 
I sleep at night just fine!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Haa. Trainer-san you're not worried about
this at all……the difference in passion.
Doesn't 
it make me look like an idiot for worrying
about it?

After letting out a deep breath and
relaxing, 
Hishi Miracle turned to me with a smile.
Even if there is a difference,
it's not a bad thing.

Compared to other trainers and their Uma
Musume, it 
really was a little different. But,
even then――

We can just do our best together.
We don't 
need to be that concerned. It's fine, we 
can still move forward together.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: ……That's…… yeah. You're right.
choice_data_list: Let's try going a little further

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Eh? What's this all of a sudden? 
Wai- Trainer-san!
It's way too dark over there――

We only proceeded a little bit further. 
But when we did,
while looking up through the trees――

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Oh…… the stars,
amazing…… they seem so close…… 
even though all we did was move to a different
spot.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
……If I was alone,
I would have missed it. I wouldn't 
have been able to see well,
and I'd be a little 
worried…… I don't think I would have made
it here.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I thought…… once again, just like normal,
the 
day would end without seeing the
fireflies 
or without anything special happening.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
…… But…… because of Trainer-san, 
I was able to experience something a little
special.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
……Could this mean that something similar
could happen again?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
……Let's try to keep things within reason,
okay? 
I'm used to being 『Normal』,
after all. ……Otherwise――

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
――I might get so surprised that I end up
crying.

She said keeping things within reason――
but, in those eyes was eagerness.
In that case, 
I couldn't help but want to respond to
that.
